text: If you want your days to go much better, do not start them with coffee and with the phone. Instead, after waking up, go to the window, and better still step out onto the balcony, and for 2–3 minutes look toward the sky (not at the sun), noting the shades of light and color, the shape of the clouds, the branches of trees, notice the birds flying by... Breathe slowly, shoulders relaxed. Besides influencing the whole day, this simple action tunes the internal clock. In a week you will find it easier to wake up, and your mood will be different.
